title: Cream puff
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

We have $N$ cream puffs.

Find all possible number of people to which we can evenly distribute the cream puffs without cutting them.

## Constraints

- $1 \leq N \leq 10^{12}$
- $N$ is an integer.

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
```

## Output

Print the numbers of people in ascending order, each in its own line.

samples.note: For example, we can evenly distribute the cream puffs to two people by giving three to each person.
